dedupe_keys.name: can train and test curated can bus dataset for automotive intrusion detection

description: can-train-and-test is a CAN bus dataset for developing and evaluating automotive intrusion detection systems. The abstract explains that the controller area network dominates in-vehicle networks and carries safety-critical messages between components such as the engine, transmission and steering column, yet lacks authentication, authorisation and encryption. The dataset gives CAN data from four vehicles made by two manufacturers, with equivalent attack captures for each model so that researchers can test how well a detector generalises across vehicles. The paper was submitted to arXiv on 9 August 2023. Coverage: four vehicle models. Format and access: described in an open preprint. Licence and cost: free to read; the data licence and host are not stated on the abstract page. Caveats: laboratory captures, not fleet data. It supports digital twin and cascading failure studies of cyber attacks on road vehicles. It relates to the HCRL car-hacking dataset and the railway cyber range dataset in the catalogue.
